title: The Migration Multi-Partner Trust Fund, as IATI records it
about: Its contributors, administrative agent, participating UN organisations, joint programmes and the countries they serve, read from the publisher's IATI activities (XI-IATI-UNPF-MPTF00193 and its fifteen children). Money and participation only: no governance and no results are published there, so the undertaking has no decisions and the partnership's commitments have no indicators until a person records them.
